analysis.summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals reported FY26 operational revenue of over USD 1Bn with a 16.6% year-on-year growth and PAT growth of 33.1%. Management outlined three strategic priorities for FY26-FY30: deepening the domestic franchise, scaling differentiated international portfolios, and translating R&D platforms into commercial launches. The company achieved strong operating leverage with EBITDA increasing by 21.8% and improved its ROCE to 23.7%. International business grew by 22.2% across Europe, Canada, and Rest of the World, supported by complex injectables and pipeline assets. Emcure Pharmaceuticals reported a strong start to the second year of its five-year strategy plan in Q1 FY27, with revenue growing 22.8% year-on-year to INR 2,580 crore and EBITDA increasing 25.8% to INR 508 crore.

guidance.claim: The company reiterates its confidence in delivering low to mid-teen revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: With that, I will complete my opening remarks. I would like to reiterate my confidence in Emcure to deliver low to mid-teen revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management remains committed to achieving 70 to 100 basis points of EBITDA margin expansion.
guidance.quote: As I have said, we expect to see positive movement quarter after quarter, and as we discussed in the past we are committed to give 70 to 100 basis points of EBITDA margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The gross margin for FY27 is expected to be around 59%.
guidance.quote: I think '27 will probably be around the 59%.

guidance.claim: R&D expense for the full year is projected to be between the 4% to 5% range.
guidance.quote: R&D, I for the full year will be between that 4% to 5% range.

guidance.claim: Management expects continued growth over the full year as the strengthened team and portfolio gain traction.
guidance.quote: Expect continued growth over the full year as our strengthened team and portfolio gain traction

demand_outlook.claim: The dermatology market in India is growing at approximately 12% to 15%.
Management expects domestic business growth to be in line with industry growth next quarter and faster than industry growth in the second half of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: From second quarter onwards, you'll start seeing us more in line with the industry and then second half will be faster than the industry growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in both ARV and non-ARV segments is witnessing growth.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing growth in both our ARV and non-ARV segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The international business experienced strong orderbook led performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently acquired a 12.05% minority stake in Gennova, making it a 100% owned subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: The third important thing that has happened is we have just recently acquired 12.05% minority stake in Gennova, making it a 100% owned subsidiary of Emcure.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin was 60.3% in FY26, representing a 20 bps change year-on-year.
EBITDA margin reached 19.4% in FY26, reflecting an 80 bps increase year-on-year.
PAT margin improved by 120 bps year-on-year to 10.2% in FY26.
EBITDA margin improved by 50 basis points to 19.7%, reflecting productivity gains and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Margin has improved to 19.7%, an expansion of 50 basis points reflecting productivity gains and operating leverage in this quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross debt as of June 30 stood at INR 1,291 crore with cash and cash equivalents of INR 189 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Gross debt as on 30th June stood at INR 1,291 crore with cash and cash equivalents at INR 189 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt is expected to increase in the next quarter due to Mantra and Gennova payouts completed in July.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt is expected to increase in the next quarter, reflecting the Mantra and Gennova payouts completed in July.

capital_allocation.claim: The company targets becoming net cash by the end of FY28.
capital_allocation.quote: Probably by the end of FY28, we should be net cash.
